data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q3 Image-to-Video with Audio

Upload an image and provide a text prompt to generate a 1-16 second video with synchronized audio and intelligent scene transitions. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_q3_image_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt:
Shot 1 (0-2s): Boy turns alarmed, shouts: "Run! NOW!" They break pose, start running right, exit frame. Snow kicks up.
Shot 2 (2-4s): Side tracking. Running through forest hand-in-hand, hair streaming, trees blur past. Look back fearfully.
Shot 3 (4-6s): Low angle. Leap over log, airborne slow-mo, land and run into mist. Dark shapes pursue behind.
Sound: shout, rapid footsteps, breathing, branches, pursuit sounds. Color: increased contrast, dark shadows behind.
